services.desc: Christmas Boat Parade Lead Boat Experience – December 13 Join us aboard the Marina Rose for the best seat in the parade! As the lead boat in Hernando Beach’s beloved Christmas Boat Parade, you’ll set the course for an unforgettable night of holiday cheer. Enjoy a festive dinner cruise complete with a delicious meal, drinks, and the magic of twinkling lights reflected on the water. Cruise through the waterways of Hernando Beach aboard our fully enclosed, paddle-wheel–style vessel—a signature experience that blends comfort, beauty, and tradition. services.name: 🌅 Last Sunset of the Year 🥂 New Year's Eve Celebration 🍾
services.desc: Close out the year in unforgettable fashion aboard the Marina Rose. Join us for our Last Sunset of the Year Cruise on New Year’s Eve, where golden Gulf waters, a glowing horizon, and an intimate onboard atmosphere set the stage for a truly special evening. As the sun dips below the water, enjoy a chef-prepared prime rib dinner, thoughtfully served while you relax in our climate-controlled cabin or step outside to take in the final sunset of the year. When the moment is just right, we’ll raise a champagne 🥂 toast together, celebrating the year behind us and welcoming the promise of the year ahead.
